messages:
ryan-pm: Quick triage: field escalations for private deploy keep coming. Main asks: an offline-friendly installer, a per-cluster 'egress fastpath' to keep IPs stable during upgrades, and a short ops playbook. Can we scope into small milestones?

ellie-eng: Suggest 3 mini-deliverables: A) airgap bundle + verifier, B) egress-fastpath advisory dry-run (no blocking), C) fastpath beta that attempts preservation with explicit abort codes.

ben-field: Two enterprise pilots are waiting on this. Advisory first is finethey want visibility before signing anything. One customer volunteered a staging window for dry-run next sprint.

kai-se: Draft config sketch (proposal):
```
egress_fastpath:
  enabled: true
  mode: advisory|enforced
  cidrs: ["198.51.100.64/28"]
  preserve_on_upgrade: true
  abort_reasons: ["kernel_replace_required","cloud_nat_change"]
```
If mode=advisory we emit warnings + metrics. mode=enforced will abort upgrades on abort_reasons.

ellie-eng: Note: enforced mode requires we avoid node replacements that change external mappings. That may block some kernel/security upgrades. We need a clear GA gating policy.

maria-legal: Legal note: any "preserve" claim needs precise language and enumerated exceptions. I can draft networking appendix text once you confirm abort_reasons and whether advisory vs enforced will be covered in contracts.

ben-field: Pilot wants: preflight snapshot, dry-run, single-node canary, then monitored rollout with abort-on-drift. They'll run dry-run first and share logs.

ellie-eng: Acceptance criteria: Airgap alpha = signed tarball + local verifier + telemetry disabled-by-default. Dry-run = `rwin upgrade --egress-fastpath --dry-run` that returns ip_drift_count, simulated_outage_secs, and abort_reasons. Beta enforced = single-node canary preserving mapping in pilot infra with rollback docs.

deploy-bot: Tickets created: PD-15101 (airgap-bundle-alpha), PD-15102 (egress-fastpath-dryrun), PD-15103 (egress-fastpath-beta).

ryan-pm: Decisions: ship airgap alpha sprint+1, ship dry-run advisory sprint+2 (pilot to validate), gated enforced beta sprint+3 pending pilot & legal appendix. Owners: ellie -> PD-15101, kai -> PD-15102/PD-15103 dry-run impl + abort codes, ben -> pilot coordination, maria -> contract appendix. I'll update the roadmap doc and add canary metrics to each ticket. :thumbsup:

ellie-eng: Will add audit-only traces so installs remain debuggable without sending telemetry. Also will include a dry-run human-readable summary and machine parseable lines for automation.

kai-se: I'll produce the sample dry-run output and a short list of abort codes for legal review.

maria-legal: Thanks. Once I have abort codes I'll put together an appendix draft and a short customer-facing FAQ (limits and responsibilities).

ben-field: I'll confirm pilot window and share contact by EOD. Closing this sync, will follow up in the PRD.
